title: The Thorn Birds
author: Colleen McCullough
summary: Across several decades on a remote Australian sheep station, the Cleary family faces drought, hardship and loss. Daughter Meggie falls in love with a charismatic young priest whose ambition pulls him another way.
readIf: you want a lush, emotional family saga with a forbidden love at its centre.
skipIf: you dislike melodrama or books where the characters make each other miserable.

pairings.reason: Another sweeping, emotional saga about a determined woman and an impossible love.
A big, romantic historical tale with an equally strong central relationship.
Another epic of rugged frontier life with great scenery, but more about friendship than love.
